The template shows retro_smarts: [C:3]-[C:2](-[C:4])-[OH] >> O-C(=O)/... etc. So it breaks an alcohol (with adjacent carbon) into an ester with polyene chain. That matches our target: the target has an ester attached to a polyene chain and an alcohol on sugar. So we can use this template.

Now need to apply template to target to get precursors. Use apply_template.


<thought>Apply template 1037371 to the target molecule to obtain the two precursor fragments (the polyunsaturated acid and the sugar alcohol).</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles":"O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O","template_id":"1037371"}</action_input>
We need result.
